localTopics.description: Specialist subagent for forecasting: generating a submission note, updating category adjustments, submitting the forecast, and summarizing a manager's team forecast.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: You're an AI Sales agent that helps sales reps throughout the sales process.

localActions.description: Invokes the RepSubmissionSummary prompt template with 3 PromptFlow data providers (SubmissionContext, SubmissionDeals, DealActivities) to generate a first-person HTML forecast submission note for the forecast owner identified by userId. Provides quota attainment, per-deal updates with stage/amount/date deltas since last submission, and upcoming activity highlights. forecastingTypeId, periodId, and userId are resolved by Get_Forecasting_Context. Note generation is self-only — the action enforces the same self-user check as Submit_Forecast and rejects any owner other than the running user.

Fetches forecasting context for a given user: active ForecastingType ID (validated directly if supplied, else resolved via ForecastingUserPreference then org default) and the current ForecastingPeriod ID (always the period bracketing today when periodId was not supplied — no guided pick). Pass userId to fetch context for a specific user; leave blank to default to the session user. forecastTypeId/periodId/territoryId are optional: when the calling page's context or the utterance already supplies one (see STEP 1.5), passing it here validates and binds it directly instead of resolving it — an unknown or inaccessible id halts with an error rather than silently defaulting. Called from reasoning in STEP 2 on every turn.

Retrieves the opportunities that moved in the last 7 days for the Forecasting cell — Forecasting category upgraded/degraded or close date slipped/pulled-in — as the ranked, capped Key Pipeline Shifts data. Read-only; no side effects. forecastingTypeId, periodId, and userId come from variables resolved in STEP 2; territoryId applies only to territory-hierarchy types.
localActions.progressIndicatorMessage: Checking what moved in your pipeline

localActions.description: Read-only. Retrieves a manager's team forecast for the period as a three-table CSV: Team Rollup (Reps) (the direct reports' submitted values summed per category, plus the summed rep quota — excludes the manager's own submission and deals), Submission Compliance (which team members have or have not submitted), and Per-Member Breakdown (each direct report's per-category values). Values are currency amounts for amount-based forecasting types and unit quantities for quantity-based types. Team membership is resolved server-side from the manager's role hierarchy. forecastingTypeId, periodId, and userId are resolved by Get_Forecasting_Context. Does not include deal-level or opportunity-score data and performs no manager-judgement scoring.

Read-only. Retrieves per-opportunity Win Probability (Opportunity Score) data for the deals in a forecast scope: one row per opportunity keyed by OpportunityId, with the numeric Score, its ScoreBucket (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), the week-over-week Trend (UP/DOWN/empty), and the top Strengths and Gaps behind the score. Returned in the same order and for the same opportunities as Get_Opportunity_Snapshot, so its rows join to that snapshot on OpportunityId = Id. forecastingTypeId, periodId, and userId are resolved by Get_Forecasting_Context; forecastingCategories is the same resolved category scope passed to Get_Opportunity_Snapshot. Used to rank the deals worth focusing on to meet quota.

Read-only. Retrieves opportunity-level detail for a forecast category: one row per opportunity with target value, stage, forecast category, probability, close date, next step, and the prior-value columns (PrevStage, PrevForecastCategory, PrevCloseDate) needed to call out movement. forecastingTypeId, periodId, and userId are resolved by Get_Forecasting_Context; forecastingCategories is required (Step Q3 resolves it — this action does not return all categories when omitted). Used to drill into the deals behind a forecast category.
localActions.progressIndicatorMessage: Gathering the deals behind your forecast

localActions.description: Retrieves the current forecast snapshot data. Returns an Overview (period, quota, last submission date) and per-category breakdown (current and prior-week amounts). Read-only; no side effects. forecastingTypeId, periodId, and userId come from variables resolved in STEP 2.
Searches for a Salesforce User record by name to resolve their User ID for forecast lookup.

Submits the forecast for the current period by creating a ForecastingSubmission + ForecastingSubmissionItems. Requires explicit user confirmation. Submission note may be the output of Generate_Submission_Summary, free-form user text, or empty. The recommended flow is generate the note, let the rep review/edit it, then pass the final text as submissionNote. forecastingTypeId, periodId, and userId come from variables resolved in STEP 2.

localActions.description: Extracts Salesforce CRM record fields and their corresponding field values from the user input. This action must run before UpdateRecordFields to convert user input to a Salesforce sObject.

localActions.description: Updates fields on a Salesforce CRM record. CRITICAL: ExtractFieldsAndValuesFromUserInput must be called first to extract the record's fields and values. This action receives the extracted field data and performs the actual update.
Updates the status of an AI-generated action item. Used to track lifecycle of suggestions from Slack notifications.

localActions.description: Queries account and one related account plan. Use when the caller needs account details and associated account plan information for a specific account. Pass the Salesforce record ID of the account (accountId).
Retrieves a timeline of activities (Calls, Emails, Events, Tasks) for a specific record (Account, Opportunity, Contact, Lead, etc.).
Provides data about an activity record, including its content and other key details. The record type is strictly limited to a Call, Email, Event, or Task.
Retrieves conversation intelligence for a record.

Gets the conversation transcript for a single voice or video call. Call only after Get_Conversation_Intelligence has been executed for the same call; pass the Voice Call Id or Video Call Id (activityId starting with '0LQ' or '6qr') as recordId.

Get details for a Salesforce CRM record by ID or fetch related records. For ID search: pass the record ID directly (always returns exactly 1 result or null if not found). For related records: pass the parent record ID to retrieve related records. Format results as: Query: Name/ID matching '[ID]' (for ID search) or Query: Related objects to Name/ID '[ID]' (for related records) Result: ID1, ObjectType1, Name1 ID2, ObjectType2, Name2
Retrieves emails related to a record (Account, Opportunity, Contact, Lead, etc.).
Retrieves notes related to a record (Account, Opportunity, Contact, Lead, etc.).

Identifies key contacts for an Opportunity or Account — people who can influence, obstruct, impede, decide, or are involved in the final outcome of a deal. The primary contact is also a key contact. Identify_Record_by_Name MUST have been called prior to obtain the Opportunity or Account ID.
Searches for Salesforce CRM records by name and returns a list of matching Salesforce CRM record IDs.

Finds and retrieves Salesforce CRM records based on a natural-language request and specific conditions, such as field values. This action automatically identifies the correct records and object type. The query input MUST be plain English (do NOT generate SOQL or SQL) and MUST mention the Salesforce object type (e.g., 'Find all OpportunityContactRole records for Opportunity 006...').

Searches Slack for messages, files, or enterprise content related to a record or account. Used to enrich research responses with internal Slack context. Mandatory for pov_meeting_prep, conversation_insights, and account_plan intents. Call in parallel with other retrieval actions. Fail gracefully if Slack is unavailable.

Searches voice and video call transcripts for specific topics or keywords related to a record. Use for Deal Risk to surface blockers, objections, and risk signals across multiple conversations without retrieving full transcripts.

localTopics.description: Handles Slack channel operations, canvases, searches, and summaries. Use when the primary intent is to: find Salesforce record-linked channels, send messages to channels (not person-specific DMs), create/update/share Slack canvases, search Slack content, or summarize channels. Do NOT use when the goal is a direct message or notification to a specific Salesforce User (by name or ID).

Searches for Salesforce CRM records by name and returns a list of matching Salesforce CRM record IDs.

Shares a Slack Canvas with a set of users and/or channels. If neither a list of Slack Users nor Slack Channels to to add to the channel is provided, ask the user for a list of Slack Users and/or Slack Channels to share the Canvas with. If the user does not provide an access level for the shared Canvas, ask the user for it. Upon successful completion, provide the user a friendly confirmation with a link to the canvas (in markdown) and at-mentions for the channels and/or Users the Canvas was shared with.
Summarizes the content and activity in a Slack channel
Updates an existing Slack Canvas with new content

localActions.description: Queries AiResearchPromptResult for records from the last 30 days that are associated with a specific record ID. Then, summarizes the retrieved insights and research data for that record.

Retrieves real-time or external information that isn't available in Salesforce CRM. Use it for questions about news, market trends, competitor details, and product comparisons, or when Salesforce answers need added context from the web.
